notes.title: Update & DLC-Release
notes.notes:
Hello progressing people,

New DLC

we have a new DLC for you to progress with: The HergornTV DLC
Never progress alone ever again with your favorite unknown streamer DLC!
Visit HergornTV; https://www.twitch.tv/hergorntv

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3276020/Progress_Bar_Simulator__HergornTV/?curator_clanid=34658072

UPDATES

Registered
All the amazing people who registered their game (like in the old days) are now in game.
You can view the register form in the dev-console and the nicknames of these amazing people too.

Experimental Steamdeck Support

I've also extended the experimental Steamdeck support.

Feature-Removal

I've tried to maintain the YouTube player asset (yes, it's a bought asset) for years now and it just keeps breaking, so I sadly had to finally remove it and with it the achievement too.
This was the amazing progress-bar-history documentation. I asked them back in the day if I can include it directly in the game (which would always work) or license it, but they sadly declined. So here is the YouTube video about the history of progress bars.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658072/18da1e9f9e96e1569cc5896f4b5f66dab146c590.png

[previewyoutube=NAYkF04IZHI;full][/previewyoutube]

NEW GAME

We are also working on a new game: Light Switch Simulator.
Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3147600/Light_Switch_Simulator/

HAPPY PROGRESSING

Thank you for your amazing support and happy progressing <3

- The SpielmannSpiel Team

notes.title: BIG FREE UPDATE & DLC RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hello progressing people,

this is not only the launch of the H.O.R.S.E. 1st DLC, but it is also a BIG FREE UPDATE to the game itself!
New Progress Bars await, and there are more achievements, minigames, a terminal based web browser, bugfixes and improvements for all you amazing progressors ːghsmileː
The dev console was massively updated with all kinds of neat and fun things to play with including the most wanted dev console feature: BACKSPACE. This update features also the first fan-made Progress Bar which was created by Punkchef-Kumpel ːghsmileː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658072/16c2f0e937a5e7f85a46e5f3b13a1e97efeb8aca.png

Become a H.O.R.S.E. 1st PREMIUM GOLD MEMBER, support us even more and get the amazing GOLDEN HORSE badge in game to show that you support us even more 💖.
But don't worry! ALL new features, except the H.O.R.S.E. 1st PREMIUM GOLD MEMBERSHIP GOLDEN HORSE BADGE, can be achieved and played without the DLC, it is meant to be purely supportive.

Update Summary:

 H.O.R.S.E. 1st PREMIUM MEMBERSHIP 👍🐴
 2 1/2 all new Progress Bars [#######   ]
 6 new achievements 🏆
 minigame: horse race 🏇
 a file system 📂
 fire horse web browser 🔖
 bugfixes 🐛
 improvements 🛠️


Browsing twitter like 1984 ːblissful_creepː

[previewyoutube=gpcP0Tg4h9Q;full][/previewyoutube]


So stay safe and happy progressing ːsteamhappyː

- the SpielmannSpiel team ːghsmileː

notes.title: 🏒 UPDATE: Super Blood Hockey ⛸️
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34658072/a68233f8e1643023a95b6d1bfb52b2bba6ad1b81.png
Hello progressing people,

we are very proud to announce that we made huge progress and finished implementing the second indie game Progress Bar in our game, the initial loading screen, the Progress Bar from Super Blood Hockey (you can checkout this awesome game over HERE), made by @LorenLemcke ːghsmileː
And because the Super Blood Hockey loading screen looks like what it looks like, there are also new sound effects exclusively for it ːmusicː
I have to say, none of us expected so much meta ever in any Progress Bar we would put into our game, but here we are with a whole new level of meta ːlunar2019coolpigː.

Big thanks and shoutout to Bre GamerRising (@friepod) for bringing this amazing game and developer to our attention ːghsmileː

- happy progressing

notes.title: 🎁 UPDATE 1 🎁
notes.notes:
Hello players,

you people are amazing!
And with this introduction welcome to the most creative name for an update ever: UPDATE 1
Big thanks for your support and love for life, the universe and progress itself.
We decided to finish and publish a bunch of things that didn't made it into the initial release as soon as possible to you.

The change log overview:

 5 new screen effects
 3 complete new Progress Bars
 2 minor bugfixes
 1 renewed Progress Bar
 new sound effects for the all new Progress Bars
 modified the main menu text a bit


keep progressing :ghsmile:

notes.notes:

Enjoy and progress where no one has progressed before! 

- SpielmannSpiel

notes.title: ITS RELEASE DAY 🎉 (kinda) 🎉
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I know you are eager to finally make your progress through computer history, but we won't make our release date (at least not on steam).
While the folks at Valve are really helpful, we couldn't resolve all issues in time, but we are sure we will release within the week.

Meanwhile you can buy Progress Bar Simulator on our homepage with a widget, play DRM free now and get a steam key that will work as soon as we get all issues resolved.

Stay tuned!

- SpielmannSpiel
